applicabilityBasis.summary: cgUSD is presented as a USD-pegged, NAV-rebasing stablecoin with USDC redemption. Cygnus Information Limited, the entity named on the issuer website, is registered in the British Virgin Islands under LEI 25490042I90M0EGQ0T03. Its exact legal obligation to cgUSD holders and GENIUS issuer pathway remain unverified. ARKS Labs' operational centres and subsidiary MSB claim do not establish cgUSD prudential authorization.

genius.issuerDomicile: British Virgin Islands: Cygnus Information Limited, LEI 25490042I90M0EGQ0T03. The issuer-hosted CGN whitepaper and GLEIF establish this entity's registration, not its legal obligations to cgUSD holders. ARKS Labs separately publishes Hong Kong and U.S. operational centres and attributes MSB registration No. 31000226418649 to Arks Foundation.
genius.notes: The Cygnus website names Cygnus Information Limited; its July 28, 2026 CGN whitepaper and GLEIF record identify a British Virgin Islands company. The CGN filing concerns a different token and establishes neither cgUSD MiCA authorization nor the legal cgUSD reserve obligor. ARKS Labs self-publishes a FinCEN MSB registration for its subsidiary Arks Foundation, not a cgUSD prudential license. Applicability and issuer pathway remain unclear/unknown. The existing authorization-negative review remains as of 2026-08-14 and is not refreshed by this October 1 domicile correction.
